rise: This branch took a hit.
People left. The work didn't.
Nothing here fell over.
The month it happened, we closed two hundred and four requests. This month, two hundred and forty.
So before Friday, look at who's still standing.
Twenty-one agents and managers. Five more behind them.
Between us, two hundred and twenty-one years of this work.
Nine of us have been at it more than ten years. Three joined in the last three.
Put us all on one line and it runs from nineteen ninety-three to this year.
We didn't go digital this year. Our first digital submission was filed in two thousand and eleven. That is fifteen years ago.
Five and a half thousand submissions. Seven thousand attendance records. Six hundred and eighty market surveys. All of it digital, long before anybody called it that.
And while all of that was happening, we rebuilt how this branch runs.
Eighteen of the things you use every day went live in the last ninety days.
And we never stopped replacing our own tools with better ones. Every screen you are about to see is real. This is what the branch runs on today.
One sign-in now. Fifty tools behind it.
The system sets your day before you're even up.
The wall shows the score, and everybody sees the same numbers.
In the last twelve months, this team closed two thousand four hundred and ninety-five requests.
Three thousand six hundred papers went through the Log Book. Nearly three quarters reached Guardian inside one working day.
On the first of August, our fact find went live again. Rebuilt from the ground up, and far more robust.
A hundred and forty-four fact finds this year. Every one of them read by a manager. Signed off in about two days. Nearly a third sent back for more work.
And since the digital fact find went live, not one of those cases has lapsed.
We have the lowest lapse rate of any branch in this company. Four point nine six, against eight point eight two.
Sixty-seven per cent of our agents are still here after a year. The published average is between fifty-five and sixty.
Production, goals, pendings, the transmittal. All of it runs live on the walls in this branch, all day long.
FY27 is thirty days old, and every goal plan is in.
And there is a way up from here. Agent, Executive Agent, Trainee Manager, Unit Manager. This branch grows its own.
The three-year plan runs to September twenty twenty-nine. Rebuild the bench, grow the units, forty agents.
The cracks are still there. We didn't hide them. They're part of the shield now.
We're not going back to what this branch was. We're going somewhere better.
Friday. Twelve noon. Ninety minutes.
Seventy-five of those minutes belong to you, not to me.
Three questions are already waiting for you. Answer one tonight.
Sign in on Friday with your agent number. Signing in is the register. Guests use the visitor code: zero, zero, zero, zero.
We rise together.
